# telnyx_email_domain_dns_records (Data Source)

The DNS records Telnyx generated for an email domain (ownership and DKIM, and MX when inbound is enabled), with their verification status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_email_domain_dns_records" "mail" {
  domain_id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `email_domain_dns_records` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domain_dns_records))
